items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: That Burl Adams -- well, it was just a matter -- he didn't have any trouble selling the group... the other guys had something else in mind. It was a setup. ... and we were lucky we came out like we did.

ctx.x: Were you making fairly good money when you were doing this?

Yes, I was making it, uh-huh. That Burl Adams -- well, it was just a matter -- he didn't have any trouble selling the group, because, see, the records was hot. But the other guys had something else in mind.
